newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to market Teheran as off-line.
newsitem.headline: Air France to market Teheran as off-line.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it will market Teheran as an off-line destination from Paris following the French airline's decision to withdraw its weekly Boeing 767-300 Paris-Teheran passenger service, effective September 14.

"Air France's Paris-Teheran service, which has been steadily downgraded in recent years, now offers around ten tonnes of palletised cargo capacity per flight and while not really adapted to the market, it did provide a direct link which is clearly a major selling point to shippers," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
Capacity was well-used on the flight with outbound shipments made up of a wide range of general cargo while carpets and caviar amonst the main goods from Teheran to Paris, he added
"We are going to maintain our cargo station in Teheran selling capacity off-line, via Dubai, using Emirates services."
Air France Cargo's agreement with Emirates on traffic to and from Iran dated back several years, the official added.

"We have around 20 Boeing 747Fs into Dubai each week and Iran-bound freight can be unloaded and transferred on to an Emirates' daily flight to Teheran when the need arises," her said so the loss of "direct" capacity will to some extent be compensated for a certain degree."
